imageReviewer.observations: Gray rectangular section with a white circular bore and thick black section/bore outline, inside the thin outline of its original clipping plane. The short central dash is the top-down projection of the original plane-normal arrow's two wings: plane_original::points creates +/-x wings around a z-normal tip. It is not a BRep triangle edge across the hole.88-caps.rs explicitly inserts the clipping Plane beside the drilled BRep and checks the empty bore. Circle outline has visible ordinary1x pixel steps, but no obvious coarse straight chord breaks. Complete frame fits.

imageReviewer.observations: Viewed the actual original 1280x960 image at original resolution. Fully framed blue pedestal consists of the authored two boxes and two cylinders. Curved rims are finely sampled without conspicuous coarse polygon chords. Historical global silhouette outlines are deliberately enabled by make_renderer; their thick black coverage shows visible one-pixel staircase steps, especially near the ellipse top. This remains a historical single-sample presentation limitation, not a claim of artifact-free antialiasing.

Finely sampled elliptical boundaries retain visible single-sample global-outline staircase steps. No separate numeric endpoint residual measured.
